name: Queen Arianna's Grilled Turbot / Pan-Seared Sea Bass
whyItWorks: Delicate, snow-white turbot and Chilean sea bass flake at the touch of a fork with virtually zero connective tissue.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Pair with creamy mashed potatoes or white rice and ask to hold any whole green peas, beans, or citrus-herb garnish.
watchOuts: Whole pea or fava bean skins on the plate
